subject: InsightForge pilot: request for credit top-up + promo discount (exec approval needed)
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@insightforge.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: leo.martin@insightforge.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot extension + promotional credits for InsightForge POC

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency and the cost signals. We ran into a data ingestion delay on our side this week which means we can't finish the end-to-end evaluation within the original 30-day pilot window.

Can Redwood provide the following so we can finish the POC without restarting:
- 6-week extension to the pilot window (new end date Nov 30)
- One-time promotional credits to cover ~75k inference tokens for evaluation of longer sequences
- A short-term promotional discount (20% off) on first-month post-trial usage if we sign a small commit (3-6 months)

If we can lock this down quickly we can move to an internal tech review and head into procurement in mid-Nov. Appreciate any flexibility here — this pilot is strategically important for our AI roadmap and we hope to scale if the POC looks good.

Attachments: InsightForge-Pilot-Specs.pdf (see usage assumptions)

Best,
Claire Hsu
Head of Data & ML, InsightForge
claire.hsu@insightforge.com

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@insightforge.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension + promotional credits for InsightForge POC

Hi Claire — thanks for the context and the attachment. Happy to help get this across the finish line.

Tentative concession I can offer subject to internal sign-off: 
- One-time free credits: 75,000 inference-token-equivalent (covers higher sequence evals)
- Pilot extension: 6 weeks (new end date Nov 30)
- Promotional discount: 20% off usage for first invoicing period post-trial if InsightForge signs a minimum 3-month commit within 21 days of pilot close

I am attaching the MAP you sent and a short summary of the proposed concession. Before I give anything final, I need an exec OK on the credit quantum and the discount. I'll loop in our Sales VP for approval and Legal/Finance for standard T&Cs.

Attachments: InsightForge-MAP-v3.pdf, proposed-concession-summary.xlsx

I'll escalate now — I'll also flag the potential upside: team indicated $200k-$300k ARR within 12 months if model results meet expectations.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: pilot extension + promotional credits for InsightForge POC — Exec approval requested

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding InsightForge's ask. Summary and ask below: 

What they asked for (customer):
- 6-week pilot extension to Nov 30
- 75k one-time inference credits to finish evaluation
- 20% promo discount on first invoiced period after trial if they sign a 3-month commit within 21 days

Why we should consider (justification):
- Vertical: fintech analytics — high expansion potential across their product lines
- Buying signals: team ready for procurement once POC completes; technical execs engaged
- Upside: expected ARR $200k–$300k if pilot passes

Proposal for approval (my ask):
- Approve one-time credits up to 75k
- Approve pilot extension to 11/30
- Approve promotional discount up to 20%, subject to a signed commitment (3 months) and PO within 21 days of pilot close

Risks/constraints:
- Credit cap exposure ~$X (see attached concession summary)
- Need Legal to sign off on revised MAP terms

Attachments: proposed-concession-summary.xlsx, InsightForge-MAP-v3.pdf, insightforge-usage-report.csv

Can you please advise quickly? Customer is asking to finalize this week. If approved I will: 1) update the MAP with the agreed concession; 2) send an exec-approved offer and MAP back to Claire; 3) coordinate Legal/Finance to draft a short commitment addendum.

Thanks,
Aditya

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -07:00

Thanks for the context, Aditya. I understand the urgency. A couple of comments and a counter-proposal: 

Counter-proposal (approved if Vivek concurs):
- One-time credits: 60,000 (vs 75k requested)
- Promotional discount: 15% off first 90 days post-trial (require signed 3-month minimum commit and PO within 21 days)
- Pilot extension: 6 weeks to 11/30 as requested

Conditions: 
- Require MAP updated and countersigned by InsightForge with explicit commit terms
- Finance to review expected ARR assumptions (Monica, please run the quick ROI)
- Legal to review the commitment addendum for early-termination liability

Please confirm you can secure the MAP countersign and PO timeline. If yes, I'm comfortable with the above and will clear this with Exec.

-Marissa Cole
